svg.aria-label: Inkling-2-Mini prefill and decode speed per optimization step
svg.text: Inkling-2-Mini on RTX 3070 8 GB - llama.cpp fork, per optimization step
tokens/s, higher is better. UD-Q4_K_M, 32k ctx, q8_0 KV (q4_0 from S10); IQ4_NL from Q9. From B10: bench.py, decode = median of 6 prompts, 2nd decode line = after a 30k prompt.
